IN PHOTOS │The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority plans to construct a rainwater impound facility inside Camp Aguinaldo in Quezon City, in line with the directive of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. for flood-resilient Metro Manila. This initiative aims to enhance the disaster preparedness and water management systems. By harnessing rainwater, the facility will help mitigate flooding during heavy rainfall.

On Friday, MMDA Chairman Don Artes and officials from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) and the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) inspected the area where the facility is planned to be built. │Joel Zurbano

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI
